dialogues.speaker: Kerih
dialogues.text: Well then! Are you interested in this strength training camp too?

dialogues.speaker: Kerih
dialogues.text: Use the equipment as you will, but judging by those sticks you have for arms... Just don't injure yourself, y'hear?

choices.text: Hey now, I exercise a ton every day.

response.speaker: Kerih
response.text: Really now? Why don't you go practice your bragging skills on that big square block next to you first?

response.speaker: Kerih
response.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Attack</color> it or <color=#00E1FFFF>slam</color> into it to score points based on your strength. Come on, I wanna see what you've got.

choices.text: I'll have you know I can send a hilichurl flying with one punch.

dialogues.speaker: Kerih
dialogues.text: ...Are you serious? You broke a corner of that block off?

dialogues.speaker: Kerih
dialogues.text: The last person to do that was Varesa... Looks like you've got a gift for this, just like her!

choices.text: It took some effort, I'll give you that.

response.speaker: Kerih
response.text: I guess appearances really are deceiving. Y'know, I'd hire you on as a coach here if you'd let me.

response.speaker: Kerih
response.text: Ah, yes. Try some of this "Fruits Aplenty." It's pretty popular amongst our trainees — word is that it can boost your athletic performance.

dialogues.speaker: Kerih
dialogues.text: Recruiting new people isn't the hard part — that comes in some time later, when lots of them start finding excuses to take the day off, or just straight up stop coming in.

dialogues.speaker: Kerih
dialogues.text: The coach has come up with all sorts of ideas to keep their motivation up, that block challenge being one of 'em.

dialogues.speaker: Kerih
dialogues.text: But in the end, some people tried to boost their scores by ramming straight into the block, and wound up all black and blue for their trouble. That just added to the number of people applying to be excused...

dialogues.speaker: Kerih
dialogues.text: Attack or slam into the block to score points according to your strength... or are you gonna give up already?

dialogues.speaker: Kerih
dialogues.text: Haha! It's been a long time since we've had a newcomer this impressive. Honestly, I'm in awe!
